about_the_game:
The Stone Golem's shadow stretches across the land, but you have been chosen to bring the dawn.

Bastionfall is a challenging third-person Action RPG set in a vibrant, fallen kingdom. Inspired by classic souls-like adventures, it features skill-based combat, deep exploration, and a unique online co-op experience. Master a demanding combat system built on dodging, parrying, and committing to every strike. Explore a beautiful, atmospheric world, uncover its secrets, and confront the colossal foes that stand in your way.

THE WARDEN'S CHOICE

You do not have to fight alone. The kingdom's shrines are protected by legendary Red Knights, bound by an ancient duty. In Bastionfall, you have a choice: defeat these powerful wardens in combat, or complete their shrines to free them from their watch. Spare them, and they will swear fealty to your cause, joining you as powerful AI companions who will fight, defend, and follow you on your quest.

KEY FEATURES

  • Demanding Third-Person Combat: Every encounter is a test of skill. Learn enemy patterns and master a combat system of dodges, blocks, parries, and powerful heavy attacks.

  • Online Co-Op: The entire campaign is playable solo or with a friend. Team up to explore the world, strategize against difficult foes, and face the final boss together.

  • Unique Follower System: Your choices have consequences. Sparing the shrine wardens will grant you loyal AI companions, changing how you approach every battle. Command your followers to be aggressive or defensive to suit your playstyle.

  • Epic Boss Battles: Challenge colossal and intimidating bosses, each with their own unique mechanics and attack patterns. Overcoming them will require all of your skill and determination.

  • A World of Secrets: Explore a rich, atmospheric world filled with hidden paths, secret Health Altars, and lore that tells the story of the fallen kingdom.

  • The Quest for the King's Sword: Seek the legendary King's Key, unseal the Monarch's Casket, and claim the powerful blade needed to defeat the Stone Golem and restore the land.

Will you reclaim the legacy of the fallen king and bring the dawn to Bastionfall?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains fantasy violence, including melee combat with swords and shields against human-like knights and monstrous creatures. Blood effects are present upon enemy and player impact. Defeated enemies leave behind corpses. The game does not contain nudity, sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, or themes of self-harm.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5.3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-compatible graphics drivers. SSD Recommended
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5.3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-compatible graphics drivers. SSD Recommended
